topic: What trade-offs exist between array size and radiation efficiency for SIW arrays in high-gain inter-satellite antennas?
consensus_response: SIW arrays exhibit a trade-off between array size and radiation efficiency. Larger SIW arrays offer higher gain but introduce increased interference, impacting network capacity. This necessitates sophisticated signal processing techniques to mitigate crosstalk and maintain network performance. Smaller apertures offer higher efficiency but limit gain and require more sophisticated beam steering. Careful design choices are crucial to optimize for both performance and compact size.
